dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - July 24, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**Rockies Stun Brewers, Yankees Shut Down Phillies in Low-Scoring Affair**

The Colorado Rockies outlasted the Milwaukee Brewers 5-2 behind a strong outing from Tomoyuki Sugano, who earned the win with 5.1 innings of work, striking out five and allowing just two earned runs. Kyle Karros and TJ Rumfield led the Rockies' offense with two hits apiece, while Christian Yelich and Brice Turang paced the Brewers with three hits each. Turang also hit a home run.

In a pitching duel, the New York Yankees edged out the Philadelphia Phillies 1-0, with Cam Schlittler shutting down the Phillies for 7.1 scoreless innings, striking out 12 and walking none. Paul Goldschmidt provided the only offense with a solo home run.

The Atlanta Braves came from behind to defeat the Baltimore Orioles 7-6 behind a strong performance from Trevor Rogers, who pitched 7.0 innings, striking out six and allowing just two earned runs. Christian Encarnacion-Strand hit a go-ahead home run in the eighth inning to give the Braves the win.

The Los Angeles Dodgers topped the New York Mets 4-2, with Roki Sasaki pitching 7.0 strong innings, striking out nine and allowing just one earned run. Francisco Alvarez hit a solo home run for the Mets.
